judgments.reasoning_cat1: A bare notice duty with no lead time or content requirement, so 'written notice of its intention' could be given at any moment before acting.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The separate Memorandum requiring thirty days' notice of any major operational change, and 16-M.3's consent requirement, both bear on the same event.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: 'no longer required because of such elimination' is a causal test left to the Publisher's designation without any standard.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: 'Prior thereto' is an imprecise temporal link and 'other available work described in Section 2' is broad.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: 'at the discretion of the Publishers' with no standard, plus 'may be done in a manner calculated to minimize the hiring of extras', is a broad and open grant.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A precise conditional restriction tied to three named holidays.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A clean cross-reference to Section 4 posting.
